notes.title: Collection Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]🛠️ Update[/b][/h3][p]The Collection Room has been updated!  
[/p][p]Enemies now have a chance to be collected when defeated,   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136498/4bbdf8170fe0d71d7b0381d649a2ee30c9d079c2.png"][/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes: [h3][b]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where selecting "Whisper" and then choosing "Lightweight" would cause abnormal HP reduction.  [/p][p]- Fixed a bug where Abyss clear was not applied when dying in Endless Mode Stage 2 or higher.  [/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some achievements were not being registered properly.  [/p][p]- You can now continue from where you left off even if you exit Endless Mode using the "Exit" button.  [/p][p]- Speed-up feature now persists into the next stage.  [/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the game would not progress properly in higher stages of Endless Mode.  [/p][p]- Fixed various typos.  [/p][p]- Optimized Chinese language handling.[/p][p][/p]
